participation.scopeLifecycle: Filter by the first completion date. Measure elapsed time from creation to first completion, including waiting, nights and weekends; exclude rework after completion. Human and Agent time follows ownership and does not represent actual working hours.
participation.scopeWeight: Shares use cumulative responsibility time, so longer work items carry more weight. Periods without samples are left blank and do not mean zero duration.
participation.scopeMissing: Work items without a completion event or an identifiable state are outside this coverage.
participation.inferred_other: Assignee type inferred from historical records: {{count}} records.
participation.inferred_one: Assignee type inferred from historical records: {{count}} record.
participation.executionTip: Include only sessions dispatched before the work item’s first completion with complete start/resume and end/interruption records. Exclude recorded interruptions and deduplicate overlapping sessions. This includes tool and network waits within sessions, rather than pure computation time. Records with missing sessions: {{missing}}; incomplete records: {{incomplete}}. These are excluded from this average; do not infer human working hours from the remaining time.
participation.refreshContent: Human–Agent participation data is calculated offline through the previous day and updated automatically each night. Manual refresh is usually unnecessary. A force refresh replaces the current cache and recalculates the data, which may take some time.
participation.refreshSuccess: Refresh requested. Data will update in a few minutes.
participation.refreshFailure: The refresh request failed. Try again later.
participation.loadFailure: Loading failed. Retry or adjust the date range.

participation.medianTip: The median reflects a typical work item’s duration. Around 90% of samples finish within the P90 duration. Compare small samples with caution.
participation.agentShare: Share of work items with Agent participation
participation.agentShareTip: An Agent participates when assigned the work item or given an execution task before its first completion. This counts work items, rather than time share or automatic completion rate.

members.empty: No member delivery data in the selected period
members.method: Tasks belong to their current human owner; Agent tasks belong to the assigning operator. Unassigned tasks and historical members are listed separately. Tasks are deduplicated by work item ID. Period totals include tasks created or having events or execution activity in the period. Completed counts follow the dashboard definition of successful delivery or completion during the period; in-progress counts use those tasks’ current states, rather than a historical snapshot. Requirements delivered count only REQ. This week starts on Monday in Beijing time and is independent of the selected period.

delivery.timezone: Timezone Asia/Shanghai · counted by calendar day
delivery.loadFailure: Requirement delivery metrics failed to load. Retry; the date span is at most 366 days.
delivery.noBase: No comparable base in the previous period
delivery.medianNote: The median resists outliers; with an even sample count it averages the two middle values
delivery.noSamples: No sample with a judgeable duration
delivery.targetSaveFailure: Saving the processing duration target failed. Retry.
delivery.targetHint: No processing duration target is set. Set one to compute on-target samples and the goal completion ratio.
delivery.targetEffect: The target drives on-target counts and the weekly goal completion ratio; changing it recomputes past ranges.
delivery.missingInvalidTimeline: Delivery started after it was delivered
delivery.method: Delivered = requirements (REQ) currently sitting in a DONE-category status node, never inferred from status names or dispatch success. Delivery completion time is the latest transition into a DONE-category node, so a reopened-then-redelivered item uses the latest one. Delivery start time is the first formal delivery dispatch. Duration is end-to-end wall-clock time, including waiting, pauses, rework and retries. Samples without a dispatch or with an invalid timeline are listed separately and excluded from average, median and goal-ratio denominators.
delivery.caption: Weeks are ISO weeks (starting Monday) in Beijing time; edge weeks only count the covered days inside the selected range. On-target judgment uses the currently set processing duration target, and changing the target recomputes past ranges.
delivery.unavailable: Requirement delivery metrics are unavailable. Retry.
delivery.empty: No delivered requirement in the selected range

model.bottleneckBody: Waiting signals are elevated over {{date}}, mainly around post-handoff state synchronization and incomplete review evidence.
model.anomalyRising: Anomaly intensity rose above the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.
model.anomalyFalling: Anomaly intensity fell below the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.

model.handoffNormal: Handoff event density is within the normal range.
model.impactHigh: May cause repeated idle rounds on the same work item
model.impactMedium: Extends turnaround time before a decision
model.impactLow: Does not currently affect overall delivery
model.recommendSync: {{worker}}: prioritize handoff synchronization and review evidence in SDLC records over {{date}} to avoid state changes without progress updates.
model.recommendWait: {{worker}}: after a review rejection, wait for a new review request before continuing to reduce repeated polling.
model.recommendAcceptance: {{worker}}: add a secondary acceptance field to frequently blocked workflows to distinguish running, awaiting decision and completed states.
model.recommendAudit: {{worker}}: increase audit sampling on anomaly days, focusing on whether retries, reopen events and state changes occur in pairs.
